en.summary: Fixes writeback-cache hazard handling so fill or flush-driven writeback activity is suppressed across BRAM read-during-write conflicts.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says this is a writeback cache bug fix.
The substantive patch is in cache RTL files that control bank hazards, fill scheduling, and data-array access.
The fix adds explicit read-during-write hazard cases and gates both fill activity and memory-request enqueue with the hazard signal.
disqualifiers: The commit also updates ci/regression.sh.in, but that change is ancillary to the hardware fix.
evidence: hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache_bank.sv adds rdw_case1 and rdw_case2 hazard logic.
cache_data.fill changes from do_fill_st1 to do_fill_st1 && ~rdw_hazard_st1.
mreq_queue_push is also gated with ~rdw_hazard_st1 so fill or writeback requests are not issued using stale data during the hazard window.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Single-ported or read-during-write-unsafe cache RAM cannot safely service a fill, flush, or eviction access while a conflicting write is still active. The old behavior allowed fill or writeback-related progress during that hazard window, which can capture stale line contents or evict data before a preceding write is safely absorbed.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A fill, flush, or eviction read overlaps with a cache write hit or replay write in the same bank or line on hazard-prone RAM.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Allow fill or writeback progress to continue during the hazard instead of stalling or suppressing the conflicting cycle.
portability_notes: Map this to the target cache SRAM hazard model; the exact signal names do not matter.
The bug is most relevant on single-ported SRAM or BRAM, or on any implementation with undefined same-cycle read-during-write behavior.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the hazard detection between cache pipeline stages or between data-array fill logic and writes.
Remove or weaken the predicate that marks the conflicting cycle as hazardous, especially for fill or flush interactions with writes.
Stop gating cache-data fill, eviction-data capture, or memory-request enqueue with that hazard signal.
Leave tag lookup and miss detection unchanged.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_cache_bank hazard logic around rdw_case1 or rdw_case2, cache_data.fill, and mreq_queue_push
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds explicit hazard cases for read-versus-write and fill or flush-versus-write interactions, then suppresses fill and memory-request enqueue while rdw_hazard_st1 is active.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove the ~rdw_hazard_st1 gating from fill or mreq_queue_push, or simplify the hazard logic so the fill or flush conflict case is missed.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Cache lines can be filled, evicted, or written back using stale data captured during a bank conflict, causing intermittent corruption or lost stores.
evidence_for_injection: The main hardware change is the new rdw_case1 or rdw_case2 hazard detection in VX_cache_bank.sv.
The fix explicitly prevents cache_data.fill and mreq_queue_push from firing during rdw_hazard_st1.
The accompanying CI change adds regression coverage, which is consistent with a real hardware bug.
notes: This is a timing-sensitive concurrency bug; conflict-heavy traffic is usually needed to expose it.
If the target cache has multi-ported RAM, inject the analogous stale-data hazard at the lowest structure that still has conflicting read/write semantics.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了写回型缓存的 hazard 处理，使 fill 或 flush 驱动的回写活动在 BRAM 读写冲突窗口内被抑制。
why_it_counts: 提交说明明确表示这是一个 writeback cache bug fix。
补丁的实质性改动位于控制 bank hazard、fill 调度和 data-array 访问的 cache RTL 文件中。
修复新增了明确的 read-during-write hazard 情况，并用 hazard 信号同时门控 fill 活动和 memory-request 入队。
disqualifiers: 该提交还修改了 ci/regression.sh.in，但那只是硬件修复的附带回归覆盖。
evidence: hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache_bank.sv 新增了 rdw_case1 和 rdw_case2 hazard 逻辑。
cache_data.fill 从 do_fill_st1 改成了 do_fill_st1 && ~rdw_hazard_st1。
mreq_queue_push 也被 ~rdw_hazard_st1 门控，避免在 hazard 窗口内用陈旧数据发起 fill 或 writeback 请求。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 单端口或者 read-during-write 不安全的 cache RAM，无法在冲突写仍未完成时同时安全处理 fill、flush 或驱逐访问。旧行为在这种 hazard 窗口内仍允许 fill 或与 writeback 相关的推进，因此可能捕获陈旧行数据，或者在先前写尚未安全落入 RAM 前就把数据驱逐出去。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: cache data-array 的读写冲突抑制
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 在存在 read-during-write 风险的 RAM 上，一次 fill、flush 或驱逐读取与同一 bank 或 line 上的 cache 写命中或 replay 写重叠。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 不要在 hazard 窗口内停顿或抑制 fill 或 writeback，而是允许它继续推进。
portability_notes: 把该故障映射到目标缓存自己的 SRAM hazard 模型即可，不需要相同信号名。
该问题最容易出现在单端口 SRAM、BRAM，或同周期读写同地址行为未定义的实现中。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位 cache 流水级之间，或 data-array fill 逻辑与写操作之间的 hazard 检测。
删除或弱化把该冲突周期判定为 hazard 的谓词，尤其是 fill 或 flush 与写入冲突的情况。
不要再用该 hazard 信号去门控 cache-data fill、驱逐数据捕获或 memory-request 入队。
保持 tag 查找和 miss 检测不变。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_cache_bank 中围绕 rdw_case1 或 rdw_case2、cache_data.fill 和 mreq_queue_push 的 hazard 逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复新增了读写冲突以及 fill 或 flush 与写冲突的明确 hazard 情况，并在 rdw_hazard_st1 有效时抑制 fill 和 memory-request 入队。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 去掉 fill 或 mreq_queue_push 上的 ~rdw_hazard_st1 门控，或者把 hazard 逻辑简化到遗漏 fill 或 flush 冲突场景。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 缓存行可能在 bank 冲突期间使用陈旧数据被 fill、驱逐或写回，最终表现为间歇性数据损坏或 store 丢失。
evidence_for_injection: 主要硬件改动就是 VX_cache_bank.sv 中新增的 rdw_case1 或 rdw_case2 hazard 检测。
修复显式阻止了 rdw_hazard_st1 期间的 cache_data.fill 和 mreq_queue_push。
附带的 CI 修改增加了回归覆盖，这符合真实硬件 bug 的修复模式。
notes: 这是一个对时序和并发都敏感的 bug，通常需要冲突密集流量才能暴露。
如果目标缓存使用多端口 RAM，就把等价的陈旧数据 hazard 注入到仍然存在冲突读写语义的更底层结构。
